text:
elen: quick thread to capture the products long-run routing commitments. trying to avoid scope creep but keep enough runway for sales asks.

ben: TL;DR: MVP = region affinity + soft-evict + visibility. Runway = residency enforcement, hard-evict automation, per-tenant budget caps.

riya: flagged: two customers need contractual residency guarantees by Q3. thats blocking their procurement timelines. we should plan a Private beta timeline.

hoz: on the infra side, residency enforcement implies pinned placement + egress rules. estimate: 4w to prototype pinning and 3w for validation w/ integration tests.

elen: can we land a minimal contract statement for sales now? even if implementation is beta, legal wants language.

ben: yes, we can ship a "beta residency" clause but include explicit caveats: limited regions, pilot customers only, SLA TBD.

riya: scope negotiation note: sales also asked for per-tenant routing overrides (webhooks) and an audit trail for evictions. propose opt-in beta for both.

hoz: risks: cross-region failover without throttles causes autoscale storm. must include a circuit breaker: max burst multiplier and a token-cost budget per-tenant.

elen: agree. acceptance criteria for MVP (short):
- policy precedence doc published (owner: ben)
- canary with 3 tenants (owner: elen)
- console shows failover events + cost delta (owner: riya)
- rollback path documented and tested (owner: hoz)

ben: add finance guardrail: default routing must not increase per-tenant spend by > 7% for the pilot cohort. if exceeded, route to cheaper compatible model variants.

riya: sample canary command for ops:
```
# route 1% traffic from tenant-omega to routing-alpha
redwoodctl routes canary --tenant tenant-omega --policy routing-alpha --pct 1 --duration 48h
```

hoz: deployment safety: automated rollback if 99th pct latency regresses > 10% over baseline OR error rate > 2% for 10m. also manual rollbacks via redwoodctl.

elen: decision: ship conservative MVP next sprint (region affinity + soft-evict + telemetry). runway items (residency, hard-evict, overrides) scheduled Q3.

ben: action items: ben -> policy doc draft (due Wed), riya -> console telemetry stub (due Thu), hoz -> throttle + rollback playbook (due Thu).

ops-bot: created ticket PRD-7890 (routing-runway-mvp) and scheduled canary window 2026-04-08T03:00:00Z.

elen: thanks. add any missed risks and Ill consolidate into the PRD before EOD. :white_check_mark:
